generator.title: Multi-model AI Video Generator
generator.page_title: Multi-model AI video generator — choose the model, then see the cost.
generator.page_description: Create with Seedance, Kling, Wan, MiniMax H3 or Grok Imagine. The workspace exposes only compatible controls and shows the exact product credit charge before submission.

model_picker.title: Choose a video model
model_picker.description: Search available production models and review their current workspace fit.
model_picker.empty: No available model matches that search.

seedance_2_5.description: The default Seedance workflow for text, first-frame and visual-reference generation.

seedance_2_0.description: Use the standard 2.0 model when final-shot quality matters more than draft cost.

seedance_2_0_fast.description: A lower-cost 2.0 option for prompt iteration and repeatable production shots.

seedance_2_0_mini.description: Test motion, framing and prompt direction before moving to a higher-cost final model.

kling_3_0.description: Single-shot text or first/last-frame video with selectable sound and up to 15 seconds.

wan_2_7.description: Text or first/last-frame generation with 720p/1080p output and optional prompt rewriting.

minimax_h3.description: Text or first/last-frame generation with broad aspect-ratio support for text-led shots.

grok_imagine_1_5.description: Text or multi-image-guided video from one to fifteen seconds; this workspace exposes 480p and 720p.
